_why: §3j.168 — the field names `scripts/extract-component-fields.py` must be asked for. The extractor selects BY FIELD NAME from argv and records nothing, so `.gamedata/component-fields.json` held whatever someone last typed. A value absent from that list is not unverifiable, only UNEXTRACTED: Helfire Tincture's burn duration sat behind exactly this and had been published as an unknown, then as 12s, when the prefab says 3. Adding two names to this list settled it. §3j.170 added the fields our stacking FORMULAS depend on: a claim on a field missing from the extraction is not reported, it is silently not checked — extractFieldClaims skips any name the vocabulary does not contain — so a narrower re-extraction would quietly retire the guard rather than fail it.
